knowledge:
- key_parameters: restarts=Determines the number of restarts with different random start guesses to find the globally optimal solution ;; use.P1=Logical value indicating whether to use the penalty on non-specific bases ;; use.P2=Logical value indicating whether to use the penalty on repetitive motifs ;; reorderings=Number of random orderings used to calculate the background distribution for scoring (higher values decrease score variability) ;; length=Length of the randomly generated initial consensus sequence (default is 10) ;; startguesses=Previously established consensus sequences passed to bcrank() to assign scores ;; do.search=Logical, if FALSE, BCRANK assigns scores to startguesses without performing a search ;; normalize=In pwm(), if TRUE, normalizes the position weight matrix so each column sums to 1 ;; revComp=In matchingSites(), if FALSE, avoids duplicate entries for palindromic consensus sequences on the reverse complement strand
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation
- when_to_use: When you have a ranked list of genomic regions (e.g., from ChIP-chip or ChIP-seq) and want to identify overrepresented short DNA sequences (transcription factor binding sites) de novo or score known consensus sequences
- pitfalls: The algorithm randomly re-orders data during scoring, meaning the same consensus can get different scores in different runs (mitigate by increasing the reorderings parameter) ;; Palindromic consensus sequences can result in duplicate entries in matchingSites() unless revComp is set to FALSE ;; Consensuses matching very few regions will not get a high T-score even if they only match top-ranked regions due to high variation in Dj values ;; Positions with letters other than A, C, G, T will not be considered in the motif search

workflows.name: de_novo_motif_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict transcription factor binding consensus sequences de novo from ranked DNA sequences, visualize the results, and identify matching genomic sites.
input: fastaFile (FASTA file containing ranked DNA sequences, ordered with the most likely binding regions at the top)
workflows.stages: 1. Load package and define input FASTA file ;; 2. Run BCRANK algorithm with restarts and penalties ;; 3. Extract top-scoring motif ;; 4. Generate and normalize position weight matrix ;; 5. Plot search path of the top motif ;; 6. Identify individual genomic matching sites for the top consensus sequence
workflows.code:
library(BCRANK)
fastaFile <- system.file("Exfiles/USF1_small.fa", package="BCRANK")
set.seed(0)
BCRANKout <- bcrank(fastaFile, restarts=25, use.P1=TRUE, use.P2=TRUE)
BCRANKout
topMotif <- toptable(BCRANKout,1)
topMotif
weightMatrix <- pwm(topMotif, normalize=FALSE)
weightMatrix
weightMatrixNormalized <- pwm(topMotif, normalize=TRUE)
library(seqLogo)
seqLogo(weightMatrixNormalized)
plot(topMotif)
topConsensus <- as.character(toptable(BCRANKout)[1,"Consensus"])
print(topConsensus)
bindingSites <- matchingSites(fastaFile,topConsensus)
nrSites <- nrow(bindingSites)
cat("Number predicted binding sites:",nrSites,"\n")
print(bindingSites[1:15,])
